blocks.text: Lim Ji-yeon and Lee Do-hyun, who starred together in the 2022 revenge drama “The Glory,” have parted ways after being in a relationship for three years. This was respectively confirmed by the actors’ talent agencies in separate statements released on Tuesday, Nov. 24. “It is true that the two recently parted ways, and they have decided to remain as good colleagues who support each other’s futures,” Lim’s management, Artist Company, stated, as per South Korean media outlet Soompi. Addressing fans, it added, “As this is the actress’s private life, we ask for your kind understanding that it is difficult to confirm […]...
